title: Strata Sync implementation capability manifest
description: What one implementation claims to support. The runner skips corpus artifacts whose `requires` are not declared here, and fails if an artifact exercises a capability that is not declared.

protocolVersion.description: Driver protocol version this implementation speaks.

corpusVersion.description: Corpus version the implementation was last verified against.

notes.description: Optional per-capability prose for anything deliberately unsupported. Keys are capability names.
